status_source: This file is the only live task and phase-gate status source.
selection_policy: One prompt defaults to one executable leaf, its focused checks and handoff. Use tools/show-task.ps1 to continue assigned work or select an unowned dependency-ready leaf. A requested group ID selects its next eligible child, not the whole feature. A leaf inherits its parent upstream dependencies and gates, never depends on its own parent, and checks external prerequisites before being claimed. Continue to another leaf only when the user explicitly requests multiple blocks or broader work. Groups finish only after all children and original acceptance evidence are complete; phase gates retain their original requirements.

tasks.title: Bootstrap the solution and repeatable checks

Pin an installed supported .NET 10 SDK patch and reviewed packages, centralize versions, enable nullable/analyzers, and add PowerShell build/test entry points.
Add Windows CI with no production keys or live provider calls.
acceptance: Clean Windows checkout restores, builds, and runs deterministic tests through documented commands.
Core and Application do not depend on WPF, Windows APIs, or provider SDKs.
Working app is a minimal shell; no feature is represented as already complete.

Verify a clean checkout can repeat the process without untracked local setup.

tasks.title: Implement domain contracts and deterministic replay
scope: Implement the smallest typed records/interfaces needed for capture, transcript events, session commands, context snapshots, and generation events.
Create deterministic clock, capture, transcriber, provider, and persistence fakes and a replay runner.
acceptance: A synthetic meeting replays without hardware, network access, or provider keys.
Events preserve session, source, stream epoch, sequence, monotonic time and UTC roles.
Interface contract version and mapping rules are documented alongside implementation.
validation: Replay duplicate, reordered, partial/final, stream-reset, and late-answer events.
Assert deterministic output for a fixed fixture and explicit rejection of invalid event identities.

tasks.title: Define identity, timing and immutable event records
scope: Implement the minimal typed session/source/epoch/sequence/revision/request values and immutable capture, transcript and answer records described by CONTRACTS.md.
Define audio buffer ownership and validate intervals, sample counts and contract versions without native capture.
acceptance: Invalid identity, revision or time-range combinations fail explicitly; UTC history time and monotonic ordering cannot be substituted.
Records preserve source identity, timeline/stream epochs and answer request fencing; owned buffers have deterministic disposal semantics.
validation: Unit-test invalid IDs/ranges, epoch separation, sample-to-duration rounding and disposal on representative transfer/rejection paths.
out_of_scope: No capture, provider, database, lifecycle controller or production transcript reducer.
prerequisites: Read CONTRACTS.md identity/time, audio ownership, transcript events and answer events sections.

tasks.title: Define the minimal service and request contracts
scope: Add the capture/transcriber/store/clock/assistance interfaces and immutable command/context envelopes needed by the initial replay.
Document contract version, cancellation/lifetime ownership and mappings to the conceptual signatures.
acceptance: Application abstractions expose no WPF, native handle, SQL connection, provider SDK type or credential.
Pause/Hide/Clear/End remain distinct commands; context and answer envelopes carry fixed session, epoch and request IDs.
validation: Compile small synthetic implementations against the interfaces and extend boundary checks for platform/provider leakage.
Verify contract construction retains versions and immutable request metadata.
out_of_scope: No production use-case orchestration or speculative full knowledge/job implementation.
prerequisites: SC-001A records and ownership rules; current architecture dependency checks.

tasks.title: Add deterministic fakes and the first replay runner
scope: Implement controllable clock, capture, transcription, assistance and persistence fakes, plus one repeatable replay entry point.
Use fictional fixtures to replay duplicate/reordered partial-final events, stream resets and obsolete answers against the contract invariants.
acceptance: The same fixed fixture yields the same normalized observations without hardware, network, keys or wall-clock sleeps.
Invalid/reused conflicting identities are rejected, partial/final distinctions survive replay, and late answers remain associated with their original session/epoch/request.
validation: Run the fixed replay twice and compare results; cover duplicate, reordered, partial/final, reset and late-answer cases.
Record the fixture format and contract mapping, keeping reference-model behavior distinct from future production reconciliation.
out_of_scope: No real provider/native capture; production lifecycle, persistence reconciliation and request scheduling remain later tasks.
prerequisites: SC-001A/B contracts compile; synthetic fixture inputs only.

tasks.title: Prove two-source capture and stream epochs
scope: Capture mic and render endpoint loopback separately through WASAPI.
Normalize on worker threads, preserve source/time/epoch metadata, and demonstrate bounded queues.
Detect invalidated devices and reopen a source with a new epoch and explicit gap.
acceptance: A headset meeting produces distinct microphone and remote streams with no intentional audio files.
USB removal/default-output change creates a visible discontinuity instead of silently relabeling the same stream.
The capture callback never waits for UI, network, inference or database work.
validation: Use synthetic overload to verify bounded memory and counted/delimited gaps.
Run physical microphone/loopback and device-change checks with metadata-only measurements.
Replay a dropped middle audio interval and verify later provider-relative timestamps map to the original session timeline, with uncertain spans labelled.

tasks.title: Acquire separate microphone and loopback streams
scope: Implement WASAPI shared microphone and render-loopback sources behind the capture contracts.
Keep callback work to bounded frame transfer, source/timing metadata and deterministic buffer/resource ownership.
acceptance: Microphone and remote frames retain separate source identities; callbacks contain no network, inference, SQL or dispatcher waits.
Opening/stopping/disposing releases devices and abandoned buffers without intentional audio files.
validation: Adapter tests cover open failure, stop/dispose before enumeration and callback ownership; run a short local source probe without retaining audio.
out_of_scope: No normalization pipeline, device-reopen policy or speech provider integration.
prerequisites: SC-001 contracts; Windows WASAPI environment and selected maintained wrapper/native bindings.

tasks.title: Normalize audio with bounded queues and gap-aware timing
scope: Normalize each source on worker threads into the initial provider format, with duration/byte queue bounds.

Dispose dropped unsent frames and coalesce gaps. Add a platform-independent sent-sample interval helper driven by confirmed or uncertain transport-send outcomes, never by queued/normalized frames alone.
acceptance: Slow consumers cannot make callback work or buffered audio unbounded; overflow preserves source/epoch and gap boundaries.
Provider-relative positions map back to original supported session intervals; a dropped middle interval never shifts later transcript time backward.
The shared timing helper uses no Windows/provider SDK types; unsent audio cannot advance provider time, and uncertain sends remain marked uncertain.
validation: Use deterministic overload and dropped-middle-interval replays to check queue limits, disposal, gap accounting and uncertainty for discontinuous spans.
out_of_scope: No connection/reconnect transport, physical device transitions or silent audio replay.
prerequisites: SC-003A frame source and ownership contract; controllable clock/fake frames from SC-001.

tasks.title: Recover invalidated audio devices with explicit epochs
scope: Detect source invalidation/default-device changes and implement bounded reopen behavior.
Allocate a new stream epoch, preserve the session timeline and expose the discontinuity or failed recovery.
acceptance: A reopened source cannot reuse the old stream identity or silently substitute another source.
Stop/cancel during reopen terminates promptly; uncertainty and known gaps survive recovery.
validation: Use deterministic endpoint-change/reopen failures and stop races; verify new epochs, visible gaps and complete resource release.
out_of_scope: No process-tree selection, Bluetooth matrix, speakerphone AEC or two-hour endurance run.
prerequisites: SC-003A/B capture and bounded normalization; fake endpoint notifications.

tasks.title: Correct normalized loopback loss under timestamp jitter
scope: Investigate and correct the observed normalized-output shortfall for contiguous loopback packets with estimated callback timing and jitter.
Preserve supported samples, bounded queues, source and epoch identities, and explicit uncertainty and gap accounting without inventing audio or precise timestamps.
acceptance: Deterministic 44.1 kHz contiguous-device-position jitter and batching cases retain representable output and account for actual resampler tails or discarded samples.
Real discontinuities, timestamp errors and unsupported overlap remain visible, and bounded ownership, no-fabrication and timing invariants remain intact.
validation: Exercise focused synthetic input/output accounting and gap regressions, including pending samples at segment boundaries, then rerun the affected local metadata-only baseline when available.
out_of_scope: No guessed physical clock correction, silent audio insertion, provider integration, or broad device matrix.
prerequisites: SC-003B/C implementation and the failed SC-003D baseline evidence.

tasks.title: Verify real two-source capture and device transitions
scope: Run a synthetic headset meeting with separate microphone and playback, then remove/reconnect USB and change default endpoints.
Record only source/epoch/timing/gap and queue measurements, not raw meeting audio.
acceptance: Physical capture yields distinct sources; device changes create explicit discontinuities and new epochs.
No intentional audio file is produced; observed queue/callback behavior agrees with the bounded implementation.
validation: Execute the relevant physical AUD cases and verify source labels, resource release, new stream epochs and gap reporting.
Link deterministic overload/timestamp results from prior leaves instead of rerunning unrelated suites.
out_of_scope: No untested headset/device support claims or broad release audio matrix; corrective defects receive bounded follow-up work.
prerequisites: SC-003A-C and SC-003E complete; interactive Windows, working microphone/playback endpoints, USB headset and synthetic remote playback.
follow_ups: Investigate loopback QPC timestamps that appeared ahead of callback time using a controlled physical timing reference; retain uncertainty unless the mapping is supported by evidence.
Measure normalized loopback gap frequency and impact during physical capture scenarios, using the SC-003E local baseline for comparison.
Run the synthetic headset meeting and USB headset unplug/reconnect test, recording stream epochs, gaps and resource release.
Verify default playback and microphone device changes and restore the user's original settings.
blockers: No USB headset with microphone is currently connected; the owner cannot connect one now. A second microphone and controlled physical timing reference are also not established.

tasks.title: Prove encrypted database and protected keys
scope: Select and pin a maintained distributable SQLCipher native build with a compatible Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.Core integration.
Protect a random key using current-user DPAPI, keep data in SidecueData outside the installer root, and prove WAL/FTS behavior.
Record native versions, license/distribution basis, and the documented SQLite WAL fix or backport.
acceptance: A wrong key fails and plaintext fixtures are absent from database/WAL/temporary artifacts.
A restart under the same Windows user can read the data; expected failure without the protected key is explicit.
FTS/search and migrations function with encryption enabled; no plaintext fallback exists.
validation: Test wrong key, reopen, transaction interruption, FTS query, migration and native-library loading on a clean Windows environment.
Inspect native SQLite/SQLCipher runtime versions, not just NuGet versions.

tasks.title: Select and prove the native encrypted database build
scope: Select and pin a distributable SQLCipher native build with Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.Core; record exact loaded native versions, provenance and license basis.
Build a minimal encrypted FTS/WAL canary probe and confirm the required SQLite WAL fix or documented backport.
acceptance: The actual loaded native library supports encryption and FTS; no compatible build means a blocker, never plaintext fallback.
Wrong/no key cannot read the canary, and tested database/WAL/temporary artifacts do not expose its plaintext.
validation: Run correct/wrong-key and FTS probes, inspect native SQLCipher/SQLite versions and scan the synthetic canary artifacts.
out_of_scope: No production transcript schema, persistent key lifecycle or installer; no purchasing/distribution-license choice beyond authorized evaluation.
prerequisites: Windows x64; an available native distribution whose use/redistribution basis can be recorded without invented credentials.

tasks.title: Protect database keys and reopen user storage
scope: Generate random database keys and protect them with current-user DPAPI and user-restricted ACLs.
Place keys/database under SidecueData outside installer-owned paths and implement same-user reopen plus explicit missing/corrupt-key failures.
acceptance: Same-user restart opens the encrypted store; absent/unusable protected keys fail clearly without creating a plaintext substitute.
Keys never enter logs, command lines or checked-in settings, and ordinary data paths remain independent of installer location.
validation: Test create/reopen, wrong/missing/corrupt key, permissions and data-path selection under the actual Windows user.
out_of_scope: No portable recovery, backup product, transcript schema or install/uninstall implementation.
prerequisites: SC-004A validated native build; Windows current-user DPAPI and a disposable synthetic test data directory.

tasks.title: Verify encrypted durability and clean-environment loading
scope: Exercise interrupted transactions and a small migration lifecycle with encryption and FTS/WAL enabled.
Repeat native loading, wrong-key, reopen, FTS and canary-artifact checks in a clean Windows test environment.
acceptance: Reopening preserves committed state and migration consistency; encryption stays active across the tested journal/temp paths.
Clean Windows loading uses the reviewed native distribution, with exact versions and same-profile key limitations recorded.
validation: Interrupt write/migration boundaries, reopen and check integrity; record clean-environment correct/wrong-key/FTS results and loaded native versions.
out_of_scope: No production-schema migration acceptance, portable DPAPI claim or release installer; report unavailable environment as pending evidence.
prerequisites: SC-004A/B complete; disposable clean Windows x64 VM/profile with synthetic data and the reviewed native binaries.

tasks.title: Prove selected-target screenshot capture
scope: Use Windows.Graphics.Capture and the system target picker for one requested image.
Show preview before explicit inclusion, dispose frames, and keep snapshots in memory.
Exercise resize, target closure, multiple same-resolution monitors, and device loss handling.

Cancelling the picker/preview sends no image and leaves no screenshot file.
Unsupported/HDR/resizing cases are reported or processed correctly under the supported matrix.

Use device-loss and cancellation fakes to verify resource disposal.

Capture and preview dispose rejected/replaced buffers and create no screenshot cache or file.

tasks.title: Verify physical screenshot selection and cancellation

Observed resize/HDR/unsupported behavior and resource cleanup are recorded with exact Windows/display configuration.

tasks.title: Connect capture to durable live transcription
scope: Wire two capture sources through bounded normalization/transcription channels and transcript persistence.
Report gaps, queue pressure and persistence failures directly to the session controller.
Stop capture in RecoveryRequired before the bounded unsaved-text buffer fills.
acceptance: Two-source speech appears live and committed segments survive restart.
Artificially slow consumers cannot cause unbounded memory growth.
Disk-full/locked-store failures label unsaved text and pause acquisition rather than claiming a save.
validation: Replay backpressure and failed writes with a deterministic clock.
Exercise real headset capture with a network interruption and validate source/epoch labels.

tasks.title: Connect the bounded two-source transcript pipeline
scope: Compose capture/normalization/transcription with finalized persistence through the established interfaces.
Expose partial/final transcript events, gaps and queue pressure to the session controller while preserving source/timeline/epoch metadata.
acceptance: Synthetic two-source events reach their correct live projection and committed store; reopened committed records retain identity.
Slow downstream consumers cannot create unbounded audio/persistence staging or erase known gaps.
validation: Use deterministic clock/provider/store fakes for backpressure and ordering, then verify committed synthetic records reopen.
out_of_scope: No failure-recovery UI, real-device verification or new provider protocol behavior.
prerequisites: SC-003/007/008/009 complete and G0 passed; bounded contracts and replay harness available.

tasks.title: Stop acquisition on persistence failure
scope: Route failed/ambiguous persistence outcomes into RecoveryRequired without depending on the failing store to report them.
Bound retained unsaved text, stop new capture before it fills, and expose saved versus unsaved state explicitly.
acceptance: Disk-full/locked-store simulations stop acquisition and never report an uncommitted segment as saved.
Already retained text is bounded and visibly unsaved; queue/gap reporting survives the failure path.
validation: Replay failed writes and slow consumers with a deterministic clock, including failure during stop and full unsaved-buffer pressure.
out_of_scope: No complete restart recovery, dashboard export or unrelated fault-injection matrix.
prerequisites: SC-010A composed pipeline and session lifecycle; injectable persistence failures.

tasks.title: Verify integrated headset transcription and interruption
scope: Run the integrated pipeline with real headset sources and synthetic speech, including a network interruption.
Reopen the committed store and compare source/epoch labels and known gaps with observed results.
acceptance: Both speech sources appear live and committed finals survive restart; interruption produces visible status/gap/epoch outcomes.
The run retains bounded queues and truthful unsaved/saved distinctions; no raw meeting recording is introduced.
validation: Record the real headset/network-interruption case with OS/device/provider settings and metadata-only queue observations.
Link deterministic failed-write evidence from SC-010B instead of repeating unrelated tests.
out_of_scope: No two-hour endurance claim or broad device support; defects beyond the single observation become corrective tasks.
prerequisites: SC-010A/B complete; interactive Windows, headset/playback, synthetic speech and explicitly enabled configured speech-provider test access.

tasks.title: Build diagnostics and the minimal transcript dashboard
scope: Add source selection, audio meters, provider readiness, session start/pause/end and a virtualized transcript view.
Expose recording/capture state and unsaved/degraded states clearly.
Provide copy/export of committed transcript text.
acceptance: Users can verify each source before starting and tell capture state without inspecting logs.
Long transcripts do not freeze scrolling or control input.
An export distinguishes gaps and provisional/incomplete content.
validation: UI Automation covers source validation, start/pause/end and export.
Load a long replay and measure dispatcher response; test no-device and denied-permission states.

tasks.title: Show source diagnostics and provider readiness
scope: Add microphone/playback selection, audio meters and provider readiness through application services.
Present no-device, denied-permission and unavailable-provider states without exposing secrets or starting capture implicitly.
acceptance: A user can identify and verify each intended source before starting; failed readiness stays visible.
Diagnostics reflect real service state rather than success-shaped mock indicators.
validation: Use focused view-model and UI Automation cases for source validation, missing endpoints and denied permissions.
out_of_scope: No session controls, live transcript view, provider account wizard or settings redesign.
prerequisites: SC-007/010 services available; Windows UI Automation environment and synthetic diagnostics fixtures.

tasks.title: Add session controls and a responsive transcript view
scope: Connect start/pause/end to the application controller and show capture, degraded and unsaved states distinctly.
Render partial/final transcript updates in a virtualized list without moving pipeline work onto the dispatcher.
acceptance: Controls display the actual lifecycle and saved/unsaved state; Pause does not stand in for Hide or End.
A representative long replay keeps scrolling and control input responsive within recorded test conditions.
validation: UI Automation covers start/pause/end and degraded states; load a fixed long replay and measure dispatcher/control response.
out_of_scope: No overlay integration, note/history editor or release performance benchmark.
prerequisites: SC-011A diagnostics; SC-007 lifecycle and SC-010 live/unsaved event stream; interactive UI test session.

tasks.title: Copy and export committed transcript evidence
scope: Provide copy/export for committed transcript text with an explicit destination and safe failure reporting.
Include known gaps and completeness markers; any retained provisional tail remains clearly labelled and separate from finalized text.
acceptance: Exported/copy content preserves source order and evidence status, without inventing final text for missing intervals.
A failed destination write cannot be reported as success, and export does not mutate stored transcript.
validation: Run focused UI/integration checks for export selection, incomplete/gapped evidence, provisional tails and write failure.
out_of_scope: No sharing service, automatic sending, notes export or broad file-format support.
prerequisites: SC-011B dashboard and committed snapshot access; synthetic transcript fixtures and writable/failing test destinations.

tasks.title: Recover interrupted sessions and incomplete endings
scope: Persist lifecycle transitions and recognize unclean shutdowns.
Implement bounded stop draining with an unresolved tail marker on timeout.
Allow recovery/explicit export of available committed data without inventing missing audio.
acceptance: A crash returns committed transcript and an Interrupted state.
Drain timeout marks the transcript incomplete and retained partials provisional.
Retry/export paths remain available after a failed write without silently replacing user data.
validation: Kill the test app during capture, commit and stop; reopen and compare committed evidence.
Simulate provider tail never finalizing and storage unavailability during error reporting.

tasks.title: Recover committed sessions after unclean shutdown
scope: Persist lifecycle transitions and detect nonterminal sessions left by an unclean application exit.
Reopen committed transcript evidence in Interrupted state without comparing monotonic clocks across process lifetimes or inventing lost audio.
acceptance: Restart returns exactly committed records and retained source/timeline identities; missing normal End does not discard history.
Interrupted recovery makes unresolved gaps and the new process timeline boundary explicit.
validation: Kill a synthetic test process during capture and commit, reopen its store and compare committed evidence and lifecycle state.
out_of_scope: No automatic resumed capture, portable profile recovery or drain-timeout behavior.
prerequisites: SC-007/008/010 complete; disposable encrypted store and controlled test process.

tasks.title: Bound stop draining and preserve incomplete tails
scope: Implement bounded provider drain on End and persist completeness without promoting partial text to final evidence.
Retain an unresolved provisional tail only under the documented data rules when the provider never finalizes.
acceptance: Stop finishes within its configured bound and identifies incomplete ending/tail evidence.
Cancellation or process death around stop cannot create a falsely complete transcript or discard prior committed finals.
validation: Use a nonfinalizing provider and deterministic clock; kill/reopen around stop/commit boundaries and verify completeness markers.
out_of_scope: No summary generation, fabricated tail completion or live-provider endurance testing.
prerequisites: SC-012A recovery path; explicit stop/drain contracts and deterministic provider fake.

tasks.title: Expose safe retry and export after recovery failure
scope: Provide recovery/explicit export of available committed data and bounded retained unsaved text through the recovery use case.
Keep failed storage/error-reporting paths usable without silently replacing newer data or claiming unsaved text is durable.
acceptance: Retry/export remains available after failed writes with saved versus unsaved/incomplete evidence labelled.
A storage error while reporting recovery cannot recurse into another falsely successful save or invent missing speech.
validation: Inject storage unavailability during recovery/error reporting and export destination failure; repeat a bounded crash/reopen case through the final recovery path.
out_of_scope: No general history UI or backup restore; share the export format contract without depending on the separately scheduled SC-011 UI.
prerequisites: SC-012A/B recovery behavior; synthetic committed/provisional data and explicit export destination.

tasks.title: Validate a two-hour transcription session
scope: Run the integrated meeting loop with synthetic/authorized test speech and real devices.
Measure latency, memory, gaps, source attribution and recovery through interruptions.
Resolve discovered pipeline defects before closing the phase.
acceptance: Two-hour run shows bounded non-history memory and responsive pause/hide controls.
Every injected outage has an explicit observed outcome and no silent transcript corruption.
Evidence states exact OS/device/provider settings and measured p50/p95 values.
validation: Exercise USB/default-device changes, network disconnect, overlapping speech, pause and end timeout.
Inspect logs for secrets, prompts and transcript content.

tasks.title: Prepare the bounded transcription endurance run
scope: Prepare a repeatable two-hour scenario and metadata-only measurements for the existing integrated pipeline.
Define timed USB/default-device, network, overlapping-speech, pause and end-timeout interventions with expected states, gaps and committed transcript outcomes.
acceptance: The run records stage latency samples, non-history memory, source/epoch labels and control responsiveness without logging transcript/prompt bodies or secrets.
The procedure names hardware/provider prerequisites and an explicit two-hour stopping point; missing prerequisites prevent execution rather than a simulated passing report.
validation: Run a short deterministic fixture to check measurement units, p50/p95 calculation and injected-outage markers.
Inspect a generated synthetic diagnostic sample for forbidden content; a rehearsal does not satisfy endurance acceptance.
out_of_scope: Do not execute the full two-hour run here or expand diagnostics into a telemetry service.
prerequisites: Integrated transcription, dashboard and recovery are available; prepare synthetic speech and an explicit device/provider checklist.

tasks.title: Execute and assess the two-hour transcription run
scope: Run the prepared two-hour scenario with real devices and synthetic or explicitly authorized speech, recording all planned interruptions.
Inspect logs and results, and turn each discovered pipeline defect into a separately bounded corrective child with affected acceptance and rerun requirements.
acceptance: Evidence records OS/device/provider settings, measured p50/p95, memory trend, pause/hide responsiveness and an observed result for every outage.
The completed run exposes any corruption, lost gap, attribution or privacy failure honestly. The parent cannot close until corrective children resolve findings and affected evidence passes.
validation: Exercise USB/default-device changes, network interruption, overlap, pause and end timeout during the run; compare committed transcript identities before and after recovery.
Check diagnostics for secrets, prompts and transcript content; retain failed results and link corrective work instead of silently rerunning until green.
out_of_scope: No unlimited debugging session or unrelated optimization; this child records the run and disposition of findings, not a claim that all new defects are fixed.
prerequisites: An uninterrupted two-hour window, physical headset/playback devices, configured test speech provider and the prepared measurement procedure are available.

tasks.title: Build versioned profiles and bounded context snapshots
scope: Implement immutable prompt profile versions and live/detailed response settings.
Assemble recent transcript, source-linked summary and evidence slots under the model token budget.
Pin transcript revision, profile version and context epoch per request.
acceptance: The saved transcript is unaffected by prompt trimming or clear context.
Snapshots are immutable and reserve output capacity within configured limits.
A profile change affects subsequent requests while earlier artifacts retain their original version.
validation: Test long transcripts, token limits, empty context, profile switching, summary provenance and stale epochs.

tasks.title: Persist immutable assistance profile versions
scope: Implement versioned prompt profiles and live/detailed response settings using the existing encrypted persistence boundaries.
Make profile changes create a new version rather than mutating configuration referenced by earlier requests or artifacts.
acceptance: Loading a selected profile produces immutable settings with an explicit version ID.
A profile edit changes subsequent selection while previously stored request/artifact references continue to identify their original version.
validation: Test create/edit/reload, invalid budgets and profile switching with deterministic storage fixtures.
Verify earlier versions remain readable and logs omit profile bodies.
out_of_scope: No context assembly, model benchmarking or profile editor UI in this child.
prerequisites: Typed ProfileVersionId/configuration contracts and encrypted storage are available.

tasks.title: Assemble bounded context with evidence provenance
scope: Assemble recent finalized transcript, permitted provisional context, source-linked summary and evidence slots under the selected model's token budget.
Count instructions/evidence and reserved output capacity; trim or compact derived context without modifying the durable transcript.
acceptance: Empty and long meetings produce a bounded context result with explicit omitted/provisional information and traceable summary sources.
Clear-context boundaries exclude older same-session material from transcript, summary and evidence inputs; trimming never changes stored history.
validation: Test empty/long input, exact budget edges, oversized evidence and insufficient output reserve.
Assert source references survive compaction and the persistent transcript is unchanged after trimming and clear-boundary assembly.
out_of_scope: No provider requests, real document retrieval algorithm or automatic suggestions; use supplied evidence through existing seams.
prerequisites: Versioned profiles and typed transcript/evidence inputs are implemented; use a deterministic tokenizer/budget fixture and reviewed model capability configuration.

tasks.title: Freeze request snapshots across profile and epoch changes
scope: Create immutable request snapshots pinning transcript commit revision, context epoch, profile version, provider/model configuration and output budget.
Reject stale assembly results when clear-context or session changes invalidate their inputs.
acceptance: Later transcript/profile edits cannot mutate a previously assembled snapshot or relabel an earlier artifact.
Each accepted snapshot identifies exactly which evidence versions and limits produced the request; invalidated assembly cannot be submitted as current.
validation: Interleave profile switching, transcript commits and clear-context while assembly is pending.
Check immutable collections/references, stale-epoch rejection and preserved output reservation without invoking a live provider.
out_of_scope: No foreground-request coordinator or UI event rendering; those remain with SC-016 and SC-017.
prerequisites: Versioned profiles, bounded context assembly and deterministic clock/store fixtures are ready.

tasks.title: Implement the streaming generation adapter
scope: Implement the initial OpenAI adapter for text and declared image capability.
Normalize streaming text, completion, cancellation, failure and available usage events.
Keep model IDs configurable and provider fallback restricted to explicitly enabled providers.
acceptance: Fake streaming responses and configured live requests use the same application contract.
Timeouts/authentication/limits return typed failures with bounded retries.
No raw model reasoning, keys or prompt bodies enter diagnostic logs.
validation: Contract tests cover partial output, mid-stream failure, cancellation, malformed events and usage absence.
Use a separately enabled synthetic-prompt provider smoke test and record the selected model/configuration.

tasks.title: Normalize OpenAI generation streams behind the application contract
scope: Implement the initial OpenAI request/response adapter for text and declared image capability with provider-specific types confined to Infrastructure.
Map synthetic stream frames into text, completion, failure and optional usage events while retaining request/session/context identity.
acceptance: Fake streams use the same application request/answer contracts as the real transport implementation.
Absent usage stays unknown, unsupported image capability is rejected before sending, and raw reasoning or provider payloads are excluded from diagnostics.
validation: Test partial chunks, completion, malformed events, missing usage and stream failure using deterministic wire fixtures.
Inspect logged metadata to ensure keys, prompt bodies and raw reasoning never appear.
out_of_scope: No live-provider calls, provider switching, request-priority coordinator or approved-image UI.
prerequisites: Typed generation/snapshot contracts and bounded immutable context are ready; verify current official OpenAI wire/SDK details before selecting an adapter dependency.

tasks.title: Bound generation cancellation, retries and provider selection
scope: Complete transport cancellation, timeout, authentication and rate-limit classification with explicit bounded retry policy.
Resolve configurable model IDs and capabilities through enabled-provider configuration; disallow silent vendor fallback.
acceptance: Cancellation disposes the stream promptly and cannot become a successful completion; timeout/authentication/limit failures remain typed and actionable.
Retry attempts and delays are bounded and never resend to a provider the user has not enabled.
validation: Use fake transport and time to cover cancellation before send, mid-stream failure, timeouts, authentication denial and exhausted rate-limit retries.
Verify request bodies and logs obey capability, provider allowlist and secret/content redaction rules.
out_of_scope: No automatic provider selection, live-model evaluation or app-level request fencing implementation.
prerequisites: Normalized stream adapter and synthetic transport fixtures are implemented.

tasks.title: Verify a configured generation provider with synthetic input
scope: Run a separately enabled smoke check through the production adapter using a small synthetic prompt and an explicitly configured model.
Record exact provider/model/configuration, streaming outcome, cancellation result and available usage without storing secret payloads.
acceptance: The live request exercises the same application contract as the passing fake transport tests.
Evidence distinguishes actual observed capability from declared support; unavailable credentials or disabled test mode keep this verification pending.
validation: Observe partial text and terminal state on one controlled request and exercise cancellation using the configured adapter.
Inspect diagnostics for prompt/key/reasoning leakage and record missing usage explicitly.
out_of_scope: No broad model comparison, real meetings, automatic account provisioning or provider fallback.
prerequisites: Configured test credentials, explicit live-test mode, provider availability and a reviewed pinned model/configuration are present.

tasks.title: Coordinate cancellation and request priority
scope: Implement a single foreground request slot with manual priority.
Cancel/supersede previous requests and reject output with obsolete session, context epoch or request ID.
Persist completed/cancelled/failed artifact status separately from rendered deltas.
acceptance: A late response from a prior request cannot overwrite a newer response.
Clear context and session end invalidate the intended work deterministically.
Manual requests are not starved by background suggestions or summaries.
validation: Race tests interleave start, clear, cancellation, completion and out-of-order deltas across two sessions.
prerequisites: Completed upstream contracts, deterministic fakes and required service seams; read the task card and relevant contracts.
out_of_scope: Do not implement native adapters, provider integrations or UI while implementing this stateful application responsibility.

tasks.title: Integrate the overlay and global commands
scope: Replace prototype wiring with a view-model-driven command bar and streamed answer panel.
Implement customizable hotkeys, explicit interactive/non-activating modes and saved monitor placement.
Connect clear/hide/pause/end to their distinct application commands.
acceptance: Answers stream without focus theft and the user can enter a question deliberately.
Hotkey conflicts are reported and disabled bindings work.
Every auxiliary window follows tested capture-exclusion behavior and has a reliable hide path.
validation: UI tests cover keyboard-only operation, rapid requests, hide/show and context clear.
Repeat physical focus and baseline screen-share checks after integrating the actual controls.

tasks.title: Connect the overlay command bar and streamed answer view
scope: Replace prototype bindings with view models using the existing session controller and request coordinator.
Render streamed answer states and route Clear context, Hide, Pause listening and End through their distinct application commands.
acceptance: Rapid requests and late events cannot make the view display another request's answer or confuse partial/failed/completed states.
Each control invokes the intended application behavior; hiding the overlay does not pause capture or end a session.
validation: Use focused UI/view-model tests for rapid requests, clear during streaming, hide/show and pause/end routing.
Check keyboard access to current controls using synthetic coordinator events without live providers.
out_of_scope: No new session/request rules, hotkey customization, monitor-placement persistence or native sharing proof.
prerequisites: The prototype overlay, dashboard commands and request coordinator are implemented; Windows WPF test execution is available.

tasks.title: Integrate hotkeys, focus modes and monitor placement
scope: Add customizable and disableable hotkeys with explicit conflict reporting, plus deliberate interactive and non-activating overlay modes.
Persist monitor placement by actual target identity and apply established exclusion/hide handling to all owned auxiliary windows.
acceptance: Streaming display does not request keyboard focus; entering question input is an explicit action.
Conflicting hotkeys report failure, disabled bindings do nothing, and missing monitors use a documented visible placement policy without false capture protection.
validation: Test saved/disabled/conflicting bindings and focus-mode changes, including keyboard-only entry and dismissal.
Exercise placement restore and auxiliary-window policy with supported monitor fixtures; preserve native-observation requirements for the following verification child.
out_of_scope: No expanded sharing compatibility claim or redesign of the prototype's exclusion API boundary.
prerequisites: Integrated command/answer overlay and prior native focus/exclusion capability implementations are available.

tasks.title: Verify focus and sharing behavior of the integrated overlay
scope: Repeat physical focus and baseline observer-side screen-share checks using the actual integrated overlay controls and auxiliary windows.
Record exact client/OS/display configuration and immediate hide behavior for unsupported or failed exclusion.
acceptance: Typing in the meeting client remains uninterrupted during answer streaming, while intentional Sidecue input works.
Every supported tested surface follows the recorded exclusion policy and a reliable hide path; untested or failed scenarios remain explicit.
validation: Run keyboard-only commands, rapid requests, hide/show and clear-context checks while sharing synthetic content.
Record the receiving participant's view for baseline share paths, auxiliary windows and representative monitor/DPI movement.
out_of_scope: No full phase-4 compatibility campaign or generic UI overhaul; create scoped corrective tasks for discovered failures.
prerequisites: Interactive Windows desktop, supported meeting client/share mode, a receiving observer, and required monitor setup are available.

tasks.title: Deliver manual meeting actions and usage feedback
scope: Add Ask, Suggest what to say, Follow-up questions and Recap with concise response defaults.
Add profile selection, optional detailed mode, provider/model status and available usage totals.
Keep factual support and insufficient-context responses distinct.
acceptance: Each action uses the current snapshot and records its action/profile/model.
An unclear question does not produce fabricated meeting facts.
Cancelled/partial answers and unknown usage are labelled accurately.
validation: Replay short technical and governance-style fictional meetings with rubric-based expected behavior.
Test missing context, unsupported facts, profile changes and usage values absent from the provider.

tasks.title: Implement the four manual assistance actions
scope: Implement Ask, Suggest what to say, Follow-up questions and Recap as explicit actions using current immutable snapshots and concise versioned templates.
Keep supplied evidence and insufficient context distinguishable; action text cannot authorize external execution or sending.
acceptance: Each request records its action, profile version and model configuration and consumes only the selected current snapshot.
Missing or ambiguous context produces an honest insufficient-context path rather than an invented meeting fact.
validation: Replay short fictional technical and governance examples through fake generation responses.
Test action metadata, empty context and unsupported factual claims with the fixed action rubric.
out_of_scope: No automatic suggestions, usage UI, live-model defaults or new coordinator behavior.
prerequisites: Profiles, immutable snapshots, request coordinator and integrated overlay commands are ready.

tasks.title: Expose profile, detail and usage state in the overlay
scope: Connect profile selection and optional detailed mode to subsequent manual requests.
Display configured provider/model, optional reported usage totals and explicit partial/cancelled/failure states.
acceptance: Profile switches affect new requests while prior responses keep their recorded profile/model identity.
Missing usage is shown as unknown rather than zero, and cancelled or partial output is never labelled complete.
validation: Test profile switching during a request, detailed-mode submission, unavailable usage and cancelled partial output.
Check view-model bindings and keyboard access without a live provider.
out_of_scope: No cost estimates unsupported by configuration, provider-account management or visual redesign.
prerequisites: The four manual actions and provider usage events are implemented.

tasks.title: Evaluate manual-action grounding on fixed fictional meetings
scope: Run the four actions against fixed short technical/governance fixtures with explicit evidence-support and usefulness rubrics.
Record results for unclear questions, missing context, unsupported claims, profile changes and absent usage.
acceptance: Each evaluated answer can be traced to its fixture, action/profile/model configuration and supplied snapshot.
Unsupported facts and inaccurate completion/usage labels fail the evaluation; unresolved failures remain visible and prevent parent closure.
validation: Use deterministic provider fixtures to verify action behavior and record rubric judgments without exact-wording assertions.
Preserve disputed or missing facts rather than treating fluent output as a pass; live model selection remains SC-019.
out_of_scope: No live model tournament or unrelated prompt refinement; create bounded corrective children for failures.
prerequisites: Manual actions and their overlay metadata/status presentation are complete, with versioned fictional evaluation cases available.

tasks.title: Select model defaults and validate assistance quality
scope: Evaluate configured candidate model IDs against fixed synthetic meeting fixtures.
Record latency/usefulness/cost metadata and select live/detailed defaults by evidence.
Demonstrate cancellation, focus behavior and context continuity in an end-to-end meeting.
acceptance: Selected models have a recorded configuration and rationale.
Live/detailed profiles meet stated acceptance rubrics or limitations remain explicit.
No stale-answer leakage occurs across request/session changes.
validation: Measure capture/STT/retrieval/model/render stages separately with p50/p95 and test conditions.
Perform a real Windows meeting demonstration and preserve a redacted evidence report.

tasks.title: Prepare bounded model-comparison fixtures and measurements
scope: Define a small configured candidate set and fixed synthetic meeting cases for live/detailed assistance profiles.
Instrument stage-separated capture, STT, retrieval, model and render measurements and usefulness/grounding/cost metadata.
Record not-yet-implemented retrieval as not configured/unmeasured. Instrument the available stages without pulling SC-021/022 into this task.
acceptance: The evaluation procedure records model/configuration versions and a fixed rubric, request budget and stopping point.
Stage samples can produce honest p50/p95 with errors, absent usage and warm/cold conditions included; preparation claims no selected winning model.
validation: Dry-run scoring and timing with deterministic fixtures, including unsupported claims and stale output.
Check that output records contain synthetic evidence references and safe metadata, not credentials or real meeting content.
out_of_scope: No candidate execution, new providers or unbounded benchmark framework.
prerequisites: Manual-action evaluation and reliable integrated transcription are available; identify enabled test providers and cost/request constraints before execution.

tasks.title: Run candidate evaluations and record model defaults
scope: Execute the prepared bounded comparison against explicitly configured candidate models and preserve result/configuration provenance.
Select live/detailed defaults from measured usefulness, grounding, latency and available cost metadata, or leave selection unresolved with concrete reasons.
acceptance: Selected model IDs and settings have a recorded rationale tied to fixed fixtures and measured results.
Each profile satisfies the stated rubric or its supported limitations are explicit; errors/timeouts and missing cost data are not dropped from the report.
validation: Compare candidate outcomes on the same cases, recording stage p50/p95, sample counts and test conditions.
Review unsupported claims, citation support and stale-answer behavior instead of relying solely on model self-grading.
out_of_scope: No unrestricted candidate search, new provider routing or physical meeting demonstration in this slice.
prerequisites: Configured live-test credentials, enabled provider/model access, approved synthetic cases and the prepared bounded evaluation procedure are available.

tasks.title: Demonstrate selected profiles in an end-to-end Windows meeting
scope: Exercise the chosen live/detailed configuration through real Windows capture, transcription, context, model streaming and overlay rendering.
Demonstrate cancellation, deliberate focus entry and context continuity while retaining a redacted measurement/evidence report.
Record not-yet-implemented retrieval as not configured/unmeasured. Instrument the available stages without pulling SC-021/022 into this task.
acceptance: No obsolete answer crosses request/session changes during the demonstration.
Observed focus and continuity match the intended workflow; profile limitations and actual tested configuration remain explicit in evidence.
validation: Interleave new requests, Clear context, cancellation and session changes while measuring the stage-separated path.
Record real device/provider conditions and p50/p95 samples, including failures; register bounded corrective children for any unmet original acceptance.
out_of_scope: No general compatibility matrix, unrelated UI polish or automatic model reselection.
prerequisites: Interactive Windows environment, real capture devices, enabled configured providers and synthetic/authorized meeting participants are available.

tasks.title: Import text documents with stable provenance
scope: Implement bounded TXT/Markdown/DOCX/text-PDF extraction and chunking.
Hash sources, version extraction and preserve page/heading/range references.
Report unsupported scanned PDFs/legacy DOC without executing embedded content.
acceptance: Malformed/oversized imports fail visibly without corrupting prior document versions.
Equivalent source content has stable identity and chunks retain traceable locations.
No document text leaks into logs or plaintext side indexes.
validation: Fixture tests cover headings/tables, Unicode, empty/scanned documents, size limits and parse cancellation.
Verify imported content and indexes are within encrypted storage.

tasks.title: Build the bounded import pipeline for text and Markdown
scope: Implement shared import limits, cancellation, source hashing and versioned extraction/chunk metadata, starting with TXT and Markdown.

Add document/version/chunk migrations and minimal typed provenance using the existing encrypted store. Persist extracted text with heading/range locations and preserve prior versions on failed replacement.
acceptance: Equivalent content has stable source identity and chunks reference their extraction/source versions.
Malformed, empty and oversized inputs produce visible bounded outcomes without leaking document text to logs or plaintext indexes.
validation: Use synthetic Unicode/heading/empty/oversized fixtures and cancellation during extraction.
Verify stored text/index representations remain encrypted and failed replacement leaves the earlier document version intact.
out_of_scope: No DOCX/PDF parsing, OCR, legacy DOC conversion, embeddings or retrieval implementation.
prerequisites: The upstream encrypted store and migration mechanism are available; this leaf owns document-specific storage/types. Establish explicit input and chunk limits.

tasks.title: Add bounded DOCX extraction with source locations
scope: Add DOCX extraction through the shared import pipeline, preserving headings, paragraphs and table locations in versioned chunks.
Treat document contents and embedded objects as untrusted data; report unsupported legacy DOC without conversion or embedded-code execution.
acceptance: DOCX imports preserve stable source/version identity and traceable locations while respecting limits and cancellation.
Malformed archives and oversized expanded content fail visibly without replacing prior document versions or creating plaintext side storage.
validation: Test synthetic headings/tables, Unicode, empty content, malformed archives, expansion limits and parse cancellation.
Verify legacy DOC rejection, encrypted persistence and document-content redaction using the common pipeline.
out_of_scope: No Office automation, macros, embedded executables, legacy conversion or PDF support in this child.
prerequisites: TXT/Markdown import pipeline works; select and record a reviewed parser dependency and its redistribution terms.

tasks.title: Add text-PDF extraction and explicit scanned-document handling
scope: Add bounded text-PDF extraction preserving page/range provenance through the shared import pipeline.
Identify unsupported scanned/image-only documents and fail or label them explicitly without pretending text was extracted.
acceptance: PDF chunks retain stable source/extraction identity and page references; malformed, oversized or cancelled imports preserve prior versions.
No embedded content is executed and no extracted text or side index escapes encrypted persistence or diagnostic redaction rules.
validation: Test synthetic multi-page text, Unicode, empty/scanned PDFs, malformed files, limits and cancellation.
Verify page references and encrypted storage, and run the shared text/DOCX/PDF import cases once to detect format-integration regressions.
out_of_scope: No OCR, legacy DOC conversion or broad content-support expansion.
prerequisites: Shared import pipeline and DOCX support are stable; use a reviewed text-PDF parser with documented license and resource bounds.

tasks.title: Create versioned embedding and keyword indexes
scope: Implement the embedding adapter and encrypted FTS/vector storage.
Use restartable ingestion jobs and publish a new index generation atomically.
Store provider/model/dimension/chunking metadata and reject incompatible search vectors.
acceptance: Interrupted indexing never exposes a half-built document version.
Changing an embedding model or dimensions triggers a separate rebuild.
Cloud-indexing disclosure matches actual document text sent to the enabled provider.
validation: Test restart/retry, duplicate imports, model/dimension mismatch, cancellation and atomic switch.
Assert no plaintext FTS database or vector file is created.

tasks.title: Implement the configured embedding adapter
scope: Implement the initial embedding provider adapter with bounded batches, cancellation, typed failures and explicit provider/model/dimension metadata.
Send only selected imported chunk text to the enabled provider and make cloud-indexing disclosure match that payload.
acceptance: Unsupported dimensions or response cardinality fail before vectors are accepted.
No silent provider fallback occurs, and document text/credentials remain absent from logs.
validation: Use synthetic transport fixtures to verify payload scope, response count/dimensions, cancellation and bounded retry.
Check the disclosure against observed request fields; no live-provider benchmark is required for this adapter slice.
out_of_scope: No index storage schema, generation publication, retrieval or optional provider routing.
prerequisites: Versioned document chunks, embedding contracts and enabled-provider configuration boundaries are available.

tasks.title: Store encrypted versioned keyword and vector indexes
scope: Add encrypted FTS/vector storage keyed by document version and index generation.
Record provider/model/dimension/normalization/chunking metadata and reject incompatible writes or search vectors.
acceptance: Index metadata makes a model/dimension change a distinct rebuild generation rather than a mixed vector set.
FTS, vectors and temporary index artifacts remain within validated encrypted storage, with no plaintext side database or vector file.
validation: Test model/dimension/chunk-version mismatches, duplicate chunk writes and generation-scoped reads.
Use synthetic canaries and the existing storage proof to check encrypted FTS/vector representations and journal handling.
out_of_scope: No restartable worker, active-generation switch or search ranking yet.
prerequisites: Embedding metadata contracts, imported document versions and the validated SQLCipher distribution are available.

tasks.title: Publish complete indexes through restartable ingestion jobs
scope: Orchestrate bounded, restartable ingestion jobs over embedding and encrypted index storage.
Publish a complete generation atomically after validation; retain the previous usable generation until the replacement is ready.
acceptance: Retry/restart and duplicate import cannot expose a half-built document version or publish an obsolete cancelled generation.
Model/dimension changes schedule a separate rebuild, and actual outbound document text still matches the enabled-provider disclosure.
validation: Interrupt jobs before/after batch commit and publication, then test resume, cancellation and duplicate submissions.
Verify atomic switches, generation compatibility and absence of plaintext indexing artifacts; repeat only affected adapter/storage checks.
out_of_scope: No retrieval algorithm, document editor or unrelated job framework; use the existing durable-job contract.
prerequisites: Embedding adapter and encrypted generation storage are ready; use deterministic transport and failure injection for ordinary checks.

tasks.title: Retrieve evidence and validate citations
scope: Combine FTS/BM25 and exact cosine ranking with reciprocal rank fusion.
Filter to selected knowledge scope, deduplicate chunks and fit evidence into context budgets.
Validate returned citation IDs and show source/version/location in the UI.
acceptance: Relevant exact terms and semantic matches can both retrieve evidence.
Deleted/out-of-scope chunks cannot enter prompts through caches.
Invented citation IDs are rejected; missing support is visible.
validation: Use a fixed corpus with expected retrieval cases, permission/scope exclusions, deletions and misleading evidence.
Evaluate whether cited text supports claims, not only whether IDs exist.

tasks.title: Retrieve scoped evidence with hybrid ranking and budgets
scope: Combine FTS/BM25 and exact cosine results with reciprocal rank fusion, deduplicate chunks and fit selected evidence into the request budget.
Filter permitted knowledge scope and index generation before ranking, and invalidate stale/deleted scope through cache reads.
acceptance: Exact terminology and semantic matches both retrieve useful source-linked chunks on a fixed corpus.
Deleted/out-of-scope versions cannot enter prompts through caches or fallback queries; every emitted chunk retains version/location metadata.
validation: Evaluate expected exact/semantic retrieval cases, duplicate chunks and budget boundaries against a deterministic corpus.
Test scope exclusions, deletion/tombstone changes and stale-cache reads, including misleading-but-similar text.
out_of_scope: No evidence UI, model-citation parsing or broad retrieval benchmark framework.
prerequisites: Compatible encrypted indexes, request context budgets and selected knowledge-scope contracts are ready.

tasks.title: Validate citations and expose traceable evidence
scope: Validate returned citation IDs against the exact evidence supplied to a request and display source/version/location through the evidence UI.
Separate syntactically valid citation identity from whether cited text actually supports the generated claim.
acceptance: Invented or stale citation IDs are rejected or clearly marked, and missing support is visible.
Evidence navigation preserves selected scope and source provenance; a valid ID cannot itself certify the truth of a claim.
validation: Test fabricated IDs, deleted versions, omitted sources and source-navigation failures.
Evaluate claim support using fixed misleading/supporting excerpts, and inspect the UI's unsupported-evidence presentation with synthetic answers.
out_of_scope: No new semantic-search algorithm, automatic fact invention or unrelated note editor.
prerequisites: Scoped hybrid retrieval and answer/evidence contracts are implemented; use fixed synthetic generated-answer fixtures.

tasks.title: Attach an approved screenshot to one request
scope: Connect selected-target capture and preview to the assistance request snapshot.
Include only an explicitly confirmed image and honor provider vision capability.
Bound and dispose image buffers after completion/cancel.
acceptance: Cancelling preview never uploads the image.
An image cannot be attached to a different request after cancellation or session change.
Target closure, capture failure and unsupported vision fail with a usable text-only path.
validation: Mock transport verifies image absence/presence by request ID.
Real Windows tests cover target selection, preview, cancellation, resizing and no persistent screenshot artifacts.

tasks.title: Bind an approved screenshot lease to one assistance request
scope: Connect the selected-target preview to the request snapshot with an explicit Include/Send approval bound to both image and request identity.
Honor provider vision capability and transfer/dispose bounded image leases through completion, cancellation, replacement and failure.
acceptance: Cancelling preview sends no image, and neither session change nor request replacement can attach that image to another request.
Target closure/capture failure and unsupported vision preserve a visible usable text-only path.
validation: Use mock transport to assert image presence/absence by request ID for approve, cancel, supersede and session-change cases.
Test disposal on every terminal path and bounded buffers without writing screenshot files.
out_of_scope: No new screen-capture engine, automatic screenshots or live image-provider evaluation.
prerequisites: Selected-target capture prototype, generation capabilities, request coordinator and integrated overlay are ready.

tasks.title: Verify approved-image behavior on real Windows targets
scope: Exercise the integrated picker/preview/approval flow against real synthetic-content windows and monitors.
Observe cancellation, resizing, target closure and request changes while checking transport metadata and temporary-file behavior.
acceptance: Only the explicitly approved image can be present for its intended request; cancelled previews produce no upload.
Failure paths remain text-only and usable, and no persistent screenshot artifact is created.
validation: Run real Windows target selection, preview, resize/close and cancellation cases with synthetic content.
Combine receiving transport assertions with buffer/disposal observations and temporary-file inspection; record the exact environment.
out_of_scope: No private screenshots, expanded capture support matrix or unlimited corrective work.
prerequisites: Interactive Windows capture environment and synthetic target windows are available; a controlled transport observer can verify image routing without real private data.

tasks.title: Generate grounded meeting artifacts through durable jobs
scope: Transactionally enqueue post-meeting generation when finalizing a session.
Generate summaries, decisions, open questions and action items with transcript references.
Version generated drafts independently of user edits and make retries idempotent.
acceptance: A failed/restarted job resumes without duplicating artifacts or overwriting edits.
Unestablished owners/dates stay unassigned and incomplete transcripts remain identified.
Generated facts refer to supplied finalized evidence.
validation: Kill/restart around enqueue/claim/commit boundaries; inject generation failures.
Evaluate unsupported claims, citation validity, missing owners/dates and regeneration after edits.

tasks.title: Durably enqueue and recover post-meeting jobs
scope: Atomically finalize the session and enqueue one uniquely keyed job referencing fixed transcript/profile versions.
Implement bounded claiming, expiring leases, fencing and retry/failure states using the existing job-store contracts.
acceptance: A crash around finalize/enqueue/claim cannot lose the required job or create duplicate jobs for the same input.
Only the current lease can commit completion; restart resumes eligible work while permanent errors remain actionable.
validation: Kill/restart the test process around enqueue and claim boundaries and inject transient/permanent generation failures through a fake worker.
Assert immutable input references, unique job identity, lease fencing and bounded retry without generating real notes.
out_of_scope: No production notes prompts, evidence-quality evaluation or user-edit versioning yet.
prerequisites: Session recovery, encrypted transactional persistence and background-job contracts are implemented.

tasks.title: Generate grounded structured meeting drafts
scope: Generate summaries, decisions, open questions and action items from the job's fixed finalized transcript evidence and profile/template version.
Retain transcript references and explicit incompleteness while treating transcripts/provider responses as untrusted content.
acceptance: Generated facts refer to supplied final evidence; provisional tails cannot become established decisions.
Unestablished owners and due dates remain unassigned, and unsupported claims fail the evaluation rather than acquiring invented citations.
validation: Use fictional fixtures for disputed decisions, missing owners/dates, incomplete endings and adversarial transcript instructions.
Evaluate claim support and citation validity using fixed response fixtures and the established generation adapter; inject generation failures through the job boundary.
out_of_scope: No note editing UI, automatic sending, broad model selection or speculative artifact types.
prerequisites: Durable jobs, versioned profiles, generation adapter and transcript-evidence contracts are ready.

tasks.title: Commit draft versions without overwriting user edits
scope: Add artifact/edit-version persistence and migrations, then commit generated drafts using idempotency keys with separate generated/user-edited versions.
Fence stale job completion and preserve edited notes across retries, regeneration and process restart.
acceptance: Repeated or resumed completion cannot duplicate an artifact or replace user edits; regeneration creates the intended separate version.
Committed drafts retain their fixed evidence/profile provenance and incompleteness/owner/date semantics from generation.
validation: Kill/restart around artifact commit, replay completion, expire a lease and edit a draft before retry.
Verify that idempotency and version selection preserve edits while generated claims/citations remain tied to supplied evidence.
out_of_scope: No searchable history/note editor UI or retention scheduler; those remain later tasks.
prerequisites: SC-024A/B durable worker and grounded generation plus the existing encrypted store/migration mechanism; do not wait for the later SC-025 editor UI.

tasks.title: Add editable notes and searchable meeting history
scope: Provide history search, transcript navigation, editable note versions and evidence links.
Export text/Markdown/transcript formats with explicit destinations.
Keep large result lists virtualized and indexing off the dispatcher.
acceptance: User edits survive regeneration, restart and export.
Search results retain meeting/document provenance and do not mix generated claims with transcript quotes.
Failed export cannot be reported as successfully written.
validation: UI/integration tests cover edit/version selection, source navigation, large history and export failures.

tasks.title: Browse searchable meeting history and source evidence
scope: Connect existing retrieval to history search and transcript/source navigation; distinguish original transcript quotes from generated artifacts.
Virtualize large result/transcript lists and keep retrieval/index work off the dispatcher.
acceptance: Search results retain meeting/document IDs, versions and evidence locations; navigation opens the intended source.
A large synthetic history remains navigable while session controls remain responsive.
validation: UI/integration checks cover source navigation, empty results and a fixed large-history replay; measure dispatcher responsiveness for that case.
out_of_scope: Note editing and export belong to SC-025B/C; do not replace retrieval algorithms or redesign the dashboard.
prerequisites: Working history/retrieval and artifact services from upstream tasks; Windows WPF test environment.

tasks.title: Edit note versions without losing generated provenance
scope: Add note editing and version selection using the existing generated/user-edited artifact model.
Preserve source links and separate user edits from later generation attempts.
acceptance: A saved user edit survives reopening and regeneration; version selection retains the correct origin and evidence.
Saving or switching versions cannot silently overwrite a newer user-edited version.
validation: Run focused UI/storage checks for edit/save/restart, version selection and regeneration while an edited note exists.
out_of_scope: Export behavior is SC-025C; do not change the durable generation worker or introduce collaborative editing.
prerequisites: SC-025A navigation and existing SC-024 artifact version/retry behavior.

tasks.title: Export selected meeting and note versions reliably
scope: Export text, Markdown and transcript formats to an explicitly selected destination using existing versioned content.
Keep evidence/completeness markers and user corrections in exported output; report completion only after the write succeeds.
acceptance: The exported selected version matches persisted edits after restart and regeneration.
Cancelled, denied, full-disk or interrupted writes are not reported as successful exports.
validation: Use synthetic edited notes/transcripts for format checks and failed-destination integration tests; verify the selected version rather than exact incidental formatting.
out_of_scope: External sharing, message sending and new document formats are excluded.
prerequisites: SC-025B note-version selection and a test-controlled export directory.

tasks.title: Implement retention and deletion across derived data
scope: Implement explicit deletion and retention jobs covering transcripts, artifacts, chunks, vectors, FTS, queued jobs and app-managed backups.
Invalidate relevant in-memory caches and prevent in-flight work from recreating deleted records.
Explain that exported copies and provider-retained data are separate.
acceptance: Deleted content cannot appear in search, prompt context, regenerated notes or queued work.
Deletion is recoverable/retryable after interruption without dangling references.
No secure-erasure or provider-deletion guarantee is invented.
validation: Test deletion during generation/indexing and restart midway through a retention operation.
Search every managed representation after deletion and validate cache invalidation.

tasks.title: Fence deleted content out of active and queued work
scope: Create durable deletion tombstones and cancel related generation/indexing work before removing content.
Invalidate scoped in-memory retrieval/context caches and recheck tombstones at job publication and request assembly.
acceptance: After deletion starts, cached or late provider/job results cannot reintroduce the target into prompts, search or regenerated notes.
Existing unrelated content and jobs remain usable.
validation: Deterministically interleave deletion with generation, indexing and cache reads; verify stale completion is rejected at persistence and presentation boundaries.
out_of_scope: Physical row/backup purge and retention scheduling are SC-026B; do not claim provider-side deletion.
prerequisites: Existing durable job fencing, source identities and context/retrieval cache boundaries.

tasks.title: Purge retained data with restartable deletion jobs
scope: Implement bounded, idempotent purge/retention jobs for transcripts, artifact versions, chunks, vectors, FTS, source references, queued jobs and app-managed backups.
Expose the deletion policy and distinguish app-managed data from user exports and provider-retained content.
acceptance: Interrupted deletion resumes without dangling references; all managed representations cease exposing the target, including backup expiry or recreation.
The UI does not promise secure SSD erasure, external export removal or provider-side deletion.
validation: Interrupt and resume a retention job; search every managed representation and verify backup policy plus SC-026A cache invalidation.
Run the deletion-during-index/generation regression cases against the completed purge path.
out_of_scope: Portable recovery, external backup management and vendor deletion APIs are excluded; stop after the documented managed-data policy is enforced.
prerequisites: SC-026A deletion barriers; encrypted storage; app-managed backup policy from DATA_AND_RECOVERY.md even before the later backup UI.

tasks.title: Prepare editable follow-up drafts and complete grounded workflow
scope: Generate an editable follow-up draft from selected meeting evidence and profile template.
Support copy/export or draft handoff without automatic sending.
Validate the full transcript-to-retrieval-to-notes-to-draft workflow.
acceptance: Drafts preserve user corrections and do not invent commitments, owners or dates.
No message is sent by generating or exporting a draft.
The grounded workflow passes provenance and deletion checks end to end.
validation: Use fictional meetings with disputed decisions and missing recipients/dates.
Verify incomplete transcripts and deleted evidence cannot silently become confident commitments.

tasks.title: Create editable follow-up drafts from selected evidence
scope: Generate follow-up drafts using selected meeting evidence and a versioned profile template; reuse existing artifact editing and export services.
Support copy/export or draft handoff with no automatic message transmission.
acceptance: Drafts preserve user corrections and evidence references; unsupported commitments, owners, recipients and dates remain unassigned or explicitly uncertain.
Generating, copying or exporting a draft never sends a message.
validation: Evaluate fictional disputed decisions and missing recipients/dates; test edit preservation, repeated generation and absence of a send action.
out_of_scope: End-to-end workflow acceptance is SC-027B; email/CRM/calendar connections and automatic sending are excluded.
prerequisites: Existing note versions, deletion barriers, profile/context assembly and export services.

tasks.title: Verify the complete grounded meeting-to-draft workflow
scope: Run a fixed fictional transcript-to-retrieval-to-notes-to-draft scenario set through the integrated application.
Check source/version continuity, user edits, incomplete tails and deletion at the final draft boundary.
acceptance: Every generated factual commitment is supported by surviving selected evidence; incomplete or disputed content does not become a confident assertion.
Deleted evidence cannot reappear through cached retrieval, notes or drafts; no message is sent during the workflow.
validation: Execute the agreed small fixture set containing disputed decisions, missing recipients/dates, incomplete transcripts and mid-work deletion; record evidence for each outcome.
Create scoped corrective tasks for discovered defects and leave affected acceptance pending until targeted reruns pass.
out_of_scope: No open-ended model tuning, new integrations or unrelated UI fixes within this verification block.
prerequisites: SC-027A integrated draft flow; deterministic providers and fictional corpus; completed parent upstream gates.

tasks.title: Harden audio selection and speakerphone attribution
scope: Add process-tree audio selection with explicit system-audio fallback.
Evaluate supported AEC capability and speakerphone duplication/overlap behavior.
Document tested headset/speakerphone boundaries and keep anonymous diarization labels honest.
acceptance: Process capture does not silently widen to all system audio.
Browser process selection is not represented as guaranteed single-tab capture.
Speakerphone limitations are measured and user-visible; text deduplication does not discard legitimate speech.
validation: Physical tests cover speakers/headsets, multiple output devices, simultaneous speech and browser audio from multiple tabs.

tasks.title: Select a process audio tree with explicit fallback
scope: Implement process-tree playback selection behind the Windows audio adapter.
Require an explicit choice before system-audio fallback and describe browser-process scope accurately.
acceptance: A missing or unsupported selected process cannot silently widen capture to all system audio.
Browser process selection never claims guaranteed isolation of one browser tab.
validation: Use adapter/control tests for selection, process exit, unsupported capture and fallback refusal/confirmation; retain source/epoch identities.
out_of_scope: Speakerphone/AEC evaluation and physical support claims belong to SC-028B/C; no custom audio driver.
prerequisites: Existing capture pipeline and native process-loopback APIs on the development Windows environment.

tasks.title: Expose speakerphone and echo-handling capability limits
scope: Evaluate the supported platform AEC capability and wire explicit capability reporting for headset/speakerphone paths.
Keep speaker/source labels anonymous unless assigned; preserve genuine repeated or overlapping speech instead of destructive text deduplication.
acceptance: Unavailable AEC or uncertain attribution has an honest user-visible state.
No text filter discards legitimate repetition to simulate echo removal; supported behavior is configurable and measurable.
validation: Replay overlapping/repeated synthetic speech and unsupported AEC capability reports; inspect source attribution and content preservation.
Record the chosen native capability and focused probe results without claiming a full device matrix.
