out_of_scope: Physical headset/speakerphone acceptance is SC-028C; do not build a new echo-cancellation engine.
prerequisites: SC-028A selection; supported native capability documentation and a Windows environment for the narrow probe.

tasks.title: Measure process and speakerphone capture on real devices
scope: Run the declared headset/speakerphone cases with multiple output devices, simultaneous speakers and browser audio from multiple tabs.
Record included/excluded sources, echo/duplication measurements and tested limitations in the UI/support record.
acceptance: Process capture and fallback match the explicit selection; browser scope is described accurately.
Speakerphone limitations are measured and user-visible, while overlap and legitimate repetition remain present.
validation: Execute the finite audio cases for the declared available devices and record OS, drivers, endpoints and outcomes; unavailable configurations remain pending.
File bounded corrective tasks for failed cases; close this leaf only after required cases and targeted reruns have evidence.
out_of_scope: No wider device certification, new AEC algorithm or unrelated transcript refactor.
prerequisites: SC-028A/B; physical headset and speakerphone, multiple output endpoints, synthetic multi-speaker/tab audio and an interactive Windows session.

tasks.title: Complete device power and sharing compatibility checks
scope: Harden sleep/wake, lock/unlock, permissions, Bluetooth transitions, docking and GPU loss.
Complete supported Teams/Zoom/Meet share-mode coverage on supported Windows Home/Pro builds.
Update the compatibility matrix with observed limits and retest affected paths.
acceptance: Resume/device transitions preserve session identity while marking new stream epochs and gaps.
Unknown or failed screen exclusion never displays an unearned protected status.
All declared supported configurations have observer-side evidence.
validation: Run the physical Windows matrix across monitor/window sharing, popup/dialog cases, mixed DPI and monitor removal.
Record exact versions and hardware alongside each result.

tasks.title: Preserve sessions through power and permission changes
scope: Handle sleep/wake, lock/unlock and microphone permission changes through the existing lifecycle and recovery boundaries.
Keep the session identity while invalidating and reopening affected audio streams with new epochs and explicit gaps.
acceptance: Resume after a power or lock transition retains the session identity and does not relabel a restarted stream as uninterrupted.
Denied or withdrawn microphone permission produces an actionable recoverable state with no fabricated capture success.
validation: Run deterministic suspend/resume, lock/unlock and permission-revocation cases, including changes while starting or stopping; record physical cases still needed in SC-029C/D.
out_of_scope: Bluetooth, docking and GPU/device replacement are SC-029B; Home/Pro matrix evidence is SC-029C/D. Do not redesign the session state machine.
prerequisites: Completed session lifecycle, capture recovery and permission-status contracts; Windows event/failure injection seams.

tasks.title: Recover from Bluetooth, docking and GPU device changes
scope: Handle Bluetooth endpoint/format changes, docking/undocking and GPU/display-device loss through the existing audio and windowing adapters.
Reopen replaced streams with new epochs and gaps; invalidate capture-exclusion capability when windows/devices are recreated until the capability is re-established.
acceptance: Device replacement never silently changes the selected source or reuses an obsolete stream epoch.
Unknown or failed screen exclusion after GPU/display recovery cannot retain a protected indicator; the hide path remains available.
validation: Exercise deterministic Bluetooth format/reconnect, dock monitor removal and GPU/device-loss events; verify source identity, disposal, gap reporting and capability invalidation.
Run focused native adapter probes only where fakes cannot establish handler behavior; full physical support evidence remains SC-029C/D.
out_of_scope: Power/permission orchestration is owned by SC-029A; no new device support claims, general driver framework or full sharing matrix in this leaf.
prerequisites: SC-029A lifecycle recovery; existing process/audio selection, screenshot resources and window-exclusion status contracts.

tasks.title: Verify declared Windows Home device and sharing scenarios
scope: Run the Home portion of the declared compatibility matrix, including Teams/Zoom/Meet window/monitor sharing, relevant auxiliary windows, mixed DPI and monitor removal.
Exercise the planned power/device transitions and record actual receiving-client observations plus exact OS, client, browser, GPU and driver versions.
acceptance: All declared Home configurations have evidence; failed/unknown exclusion remains visibly unprotected with an immediate hide path.
Device/power transitions retain session identity and report new stream epochs and gaps.
validation: Execute the finite Home case list from WINDOWS_TEST_MATRIX.md, preserving failed and unavailable cases; compare results with advertised capability status.
Create scoped corrections for failed handlers; mark required cases pending until those corrections and affected reruns pass.
out_of_scope: Pro coverage is SC-029D; do not expand the advertised support matrix or perform unbounded fixes during a run.
prerequisites: SC-029A/B; a supported Windows Home environment, required clients, mixed-DPI monitors and receiving observer/client; physical device/power control.

tasks.title: Verify declared Windows Pro scenarios and reconcile support claims
scope: Run the Pro portion of the same declared matrix, with actual remote observations and device/power transitions.
Reconcile Home and Pro evidence into one supported-configuration record without broadening claims beyond tested cases.
acceptance: Every declared supported Home/Pro scenario points to its actual environment and result; missing or failed required scenarios keep the parent pending.
Unknown or failed exclusion never shows an unearned protected state, and required device transition cases preserve identity/gaps.
validation: Execute Pro monitor/window/tab and auxiliary-window/DPI cases prescribed by the matrix; record exact environment versions and relevant power/device outcomes.
Review both batches against support claims, link scoped fixes and retest only affected failed paths before closure.
out_of_scope: No certification claim, new platform support or unrelated repair campaign.
prerequisites: SC-029C evidence; supported Windows Pro environment, declared meeting clients/browsers, monitors/devices and receiving observer/client.

tasks.title: Finish onboarding accessibility and language behavior
scope: Add first-run provider/capture setup, clear cloud-processing disclosure and interactive diagnostics.
Verify keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, contrast and scalable text.
Test explicit transcription/output language settings and per-language limitations.
acceptance: A new user can establish working sources and providers without developer tools.
Core meeting controls and history are operable with keyboard and assistive technology.
Unsupported language/model combinations are prevented or clearly identified.
validation: Run clean-profile onboarding and real screen-reader/keyboard checks.
Use multilingual fixtures and expanded/long localized strings without clipping.

tasks.title: Implement first-run provider and capture setup
scope: Add first-run source/provider setup with clear cloud-processing disclosure and interactive diagnostics.
Reuse credential protection and capability reporting; make failures actionable without requiring developer tools.
acceptance: The flow can configure and validate sources/providers, recover from missing permissions or credentials, and accurately explain external processing.
Secrets and meeting content do not enter setup diagnostics or logs.
validation: Run focused view-model/UI tests for empty configuration, invalid credentials, unavailable source and successful fake readiness; reserve clean-profile real-device proof for SC-030D.
out_of_scope: Accessibility/language changes are SC-030B/C; do not add accounts, hosted onboarding or automatic consent.
prerequisites: Existing provider credential protection, capture diagnostics and explicit provider-enable controls.

tasks.title: Make core controls and history accessible
scope: Implement keyboard navigation, focus order, screen-reader labels, system contrast and scalable text for existing meeting controls, onboarding and history.
Ensure status changes and meaningful control names are exposed without reading hidden/sensitive content unnecessarily.
acceptance: Core controls and history have usable keyboard paths and automation semantics.
Large text and high contrast preserve usable content and actions without clipped controls.
validation: Run focused UI automation for focus/navigation and accessible names plus layout checks at declared text scales; real screen-reader interaction remains SC-030E.
out_of_scope: No broad visual redesign or new controls/features beyond correcting accessibility of existing flows.
prerequisites: SC-030A and completed core/history views; Windows UI Automation environment.

tasks.title: Validate input/output language settings and limitations
scope: Keep transcription language and response language as separate explicit settings; validate choices against configured model capabilities.
Display limitations for unsupported combinations and preserve usability with multilingual/long text.
acceptance: Unsupported language/model combinations are prevented or clearly identified.
Language selections survive normal settings use without silently changing provider or dropping evidence metadata.
validation: Use a bounded multilingual fixture set and capability fakes for supported/unsupported combinations; test long localized strings and expanded text for clipping.
out_of_scope: No new translation service or unsupported language-quality claims; external language proof is SC-030F.
prerequisites: SC-030A/B; recorded provider/model capability metadata and explicit input/output language contracts.

tasks.title: Verify clean-profile onboarding with real sources and providers
scope: Run the implemented first-run flow in a clean Windows user profile, establishing real capture sources and explicitly enabled test providers through the product UI.
Verify cloud-processing disclosure, source/provider readiness and recovery from missing permission or invalid test configuration.
acceptance: A new user can establish working sources and providers without developer tools or editing internal configuration files.
Observed data flows match the onboarding disclosure, and failure/retry paths remain actionable without exposing credentials.
validation: Execute the finite clean-profile onboarding cases from SC-030A with synthetic speech and test credentials; record success, permission denial and invalid-provider-configuration outcomes.
File bounded corrective tasks for failed steps and leave this verification pending until their affected reruns succeed.
out_of_scope: Assistive-technology verification is SC-030E and language proof is SC-030F; no new account flow or unrelated settings implementation.
prerequisites: SC-030A/B/C implementations; interactive Windows clean user profile, real microphone/playback sources, enabled test-provider credentials and synthetic speech.

tasks.title: Verify keyboard, screen-reader and scalable-text access
scope: Exercise the existing onboarding, core meeting controls and history using keyboard-only navigation and an actual screen reader.
Check names, focus order, status announcements, high contrast and declared text scales, including expanded interface strings.
acceptance: Core controls and history are operable with keyboard and assistive technology; focus and spoken state match the actual action/status.
Contrast and enlarged text preserve access to required controls without clipping or hiding meaningful content.
validation: Run the finite accessibility paths defined in SC-030B with recorded screen-reader/Windows versions, keyboard sequence and scale/contrast settings.
Preserve failed observations and route corrections into scoped tasks; repeat only affected accessibility paths before closure.
out_of_scope: No general UI redesign, accessibility certification or multilingual provider benchmark; language settings/quality evidence belongs to SC-030F.
prerequisites: SC-030B implementation and SC-030D usable configured profile; interactive Windows, an actual screen reader, keyboard and supported scale/contrast settings.

tasks.title: Verify declared transcription and output language combinations
scope: Run the bounded multilingual fixture set against the explicitly declared input/output language and provider/model combinations from SC-030C.
Check unsupported-combination warnings, provider capability limitations and long localized transcript/response/interface text in the actual Windows views.
acceptance: Supported language settings match observed provider/model behavior; unsupported combinations are prevented or clearly identified without a silent provider switch.
The declared multilingual and expanded-text cases remain usable without clipped required controls or loss of evidence metadata.
validation: Record exact model/configuration, input/output language pair and outcome for each declared fixture case, retaining missing or failing evidence explicitly.
Check the long localized-string layouts and route failures to scoped fixes with targeted reruns; do not silently narrow existing support claims to pass.
out_of_scope: No new languages, translation service, unrelated model tuning or broad certification; stop after the declared language/configuration set is assessed.
prerequisites: SC-030C implementation, configured SC-030D profile and SC-030E accessibility results; enabled test providers for declared languages, synthetic multilingual speech/text and interactive Windows.

tasks.title: Harden signed updates and release installation
scope: Implement update checks and safe application only after the session stops.
Verify signed release artifacts/update source validation and failed-update recovery.
Check schema compatibility, downgrade handling, data preservation and explicit delete-data behavior.
acceptance: An active meeting cannot be interrupted by automatic update/restart.
An invalid or untrusted update is rejected.
Clean install, upgrade, reinstall and uninstall behavior match documented data policy.
validation: Run clean Windows standard-user install and real signed upgrade with interrupted download/apply scenarios.
Record certificate/update trust behavior and ensure no credentials enter packages.

tasks.title: Apply updates only at safe session boundaries
scope: Implement update discovery/download orchestration and defer application/restart until the session has stopped safely.
Represent checking, available, downloaded, deferred and failed states without disrupting capture or losing pending work.
acceptance: An active or stopping meeting cannot be interrupted by automatic update/restart.
Cancellation and download failure leave the current application usable and allow a bounded retry.
validation: Use deterministic update-source/session fakes to race update readiness with start, pause, stop and failure; confirm no apply/restart while the session is active.
out_of_scope: Trust/schema recovery is SC-031B and real signed upgrades are SC-031C; no auto-publication or new update service.
prerequisites: Existing packaging/update framework and lifecycle stop/drain semantics.

tasks.title: Validate update trust and recover compatible data safely
scope: Reject invalid release signatures or untrusted update sources; record trust failures without secrets.
Handle failed application, schema compatibility/downgrade refusal and rollback limitations while preserving data; distinguish explicit delete-data from ordinary uninstall.
acceptance: Untrusted updates cannot be applied and unsupported newer schemas cannot be written by an older build.
Failed update/recovery preserves available user data and keys; ordinary uninstall remains data-preserving.
validation: Test invalid/untrusted metadata, interrupted download/apply, supported upgrade and incompatible downgrade with synthetic stores and controlled update fixtures.
Review package-input handling so signing/provider credentials cannot be included in produced artifacts.
out_of_scope: Actual signed standard-user lifecycle proof is SC-031C; no portable key recovery or automatic destructive rollback.
prerequisites: SC-031A; documented update trust design, supported schema ranges and test fixtures that do not contain production signing secrets.

tasks.title: Verify signed installation, upgrade and data preservation
scope: Build reviewable signed test artifacts and exercise clean standard-user install, signed upgrade, interruption recovery, reinstall and ordinary uninstall.
Check real certificate/source trust, schema/downgrade outcomes, data/key preservation and the separately explicit delete-data operation.
acceptance: Real signed updates succeed only for trusted inputs and do not interrupt an active session; untrusted or interrupted updates fail/recover as documented.
Install/upgrade/reinstall/uninstall match data policy; no credential or private content is packaged.
validation: Run the finite lifecycle and interruption cases on a clean Windows environment, inspect package contents and record signature/trust observations.
File bounded corrective tasks for failed cases and repeat only affected scenarios before accepting the lifecycle proof.
out_of_scope: No public publishing, infrastructure purchase or broad signing/account configuration beyond supplied authorized test capability.
prerequisites: SC-031A/B; available authorized signing capability and trusted test update source; clean Windows standard-user environment and synthetic persisted data.

tasks.title: Validate encrypted backup and restore boundaries
scope: Implement consistent encrypted database snapshots and same-profile restore.
Keep key/backups outside the installer root and label original-profile dependency.
Defer portable passphrase export until independently designed and tested; do not imply DPAPI is portable.
acceptance: A backup captured during activity restores a consistent committed state in the original usable profile.
Wrong/missing key and lost-profile scenarios fail clearly without plaintext fallback.
Restore cannot silently replace newer user data or bypass deletion/retention rules.
validation: Restore snapshots from active WAL, after upgrade and after ordinary reinstall.
Test absent/corrupt key and backup with an explicit rollback/recovery plan.

tasks.title: Create consistent encrypted snapshots during activity
scope: Use the validated encrypted backup API to snapshot committed state while WAL is active, without plaintext intermediate files.
Store backup/key material outside installer directories and apply existing access, retention and deletion policies.
acceptance: A snapshot taken during writes represents a consistent committed state and retains required key/schema metadata.
Backups remain encrypted and follow app-managed expiry/recreation policy; original-profile dependence is explicitly described.
validation: Run native encrypted-store tests with active WAL writes, interrupted snapshot creation and synthetic canaries; verify integrity and encryption of successful snapshots.
out_of_scope: Restore UI and physical reinstall/profile evidence are SC-032B/C; portable passphrase export is excluded.
prerequisites: Validated SQLCipher build, serialized writer, DPAPI key store and implemented retention/deletion policy.

tasks.title: Restore snapshots with explicit data and key safeguards
scope: Implement same-profile restore validation and a recovery flow that preserves an explicit rollback path.
Check key availability, encryption, integrity, schema compatibility and retention/deletion rules before replacing data; require explicit handling of newer local data.
acceptance: Wrong, absent or corrupt key/backup fails clearly with no plaintext fallback or silent data replacement.
The restore flow labels original-profile dependency and cannot bypass deletion policy or promise lost-profile portability.
validation: Test valid restore, corrupt snapshot, missing/wrong key, incompatible schema, newer local data and interrupted replacement with an explicit rollback plan.
out_of_scope: Cross-profile physical proof and upgrade/reinstall evidence are SC-032C; no portable export design.
prerequisites: SC-032A encrypted snapshots and controlled test stores/keys; documented recovery policy.

tasks.title: Verify recovery across WAL, upgrades and Windows profiles
scope: Restore snapshots from active WAL and after upgrade or ordinary reinstall in the original usable Windows profile.
Demonstrate missing/corrupt key and lost-profile limitations using disposable test profiles, and verify the documented rollback plan.
acceptance: Restored committed data is consistent, encrypted and policy-compliant in the original profile.
Lost-profile/key cases fail honestly; no portable recovery or silent replacement of newer data is claimed.
validation: Execute the bounded backup/restore matrix with synthetic stores, recording original-profile success, wrong/missing-key failures and post-upgrade/reinstall outcomes.
Compare restored content, key location, retention effects and rollback observations; track failed cases as scoped corrective work.
out_of_scope: Do not delete a real user profile or use production meeting data; portable passphrase recovery remains deferred.
prerequisites: SC-032A/B; interactive Windows with disposable profiles, reviewed installer/update artifacts and an isolated synthetic database/key set.

tasks.title: Run soak performance and privacy acceptance
scope: Run overnight synthetic/authorized meeting soak and measured performance scenarios.
Inspect logs/temp/cache/crash behavior for raw audio, screenshots, keys and unintended plaintext.
Exercise fault injection and address measurable regressions before release.
acceptance: Non-history memory remains bounded, controls stay responsive, and measurements include test conditions.
Transcript/provider/storage failures are visible and recoverable within documented limits.
Captured content is absent from automatic diagnostics and app-created raw-media files.
validation: Measure p50/p95 stage latency and compare to engineering targets with no unsupported marketing claims.
Run disk-full, network faults, long transcript, deletion during work, cancellation and restart scenarios.

tasks.title: Prepare bounded soak, fault and privacy measurements
scope: Prepare the overnight run procedure, synthetic workload and metadata-only diagnostics for queue/memory trends, control response and stage timing.
Prepare the finite disk-full, network, long-transcript, concurrent deletion, cancellation and restart fault cases plus a privacy artifact inventory.
acceptance: Measurements distinguish durable history growth from transient memory and retain failed/timed-out samples.
Diagnostics can measure p50/p95 without capturing raw audio, screenshots, keys, prompts or transcript bodies.
validation: Run a short deterministic fixture to verify metric aggregation, fault triggers and privacy-canary inspection; do not treat the short run as overnight acceptance.
out_of_scope: The real overnight run is SC-033B; full fault/privacy observations are SC-033C. No speculative benchmark framework.
prerequisites: Completed upstream integrated features and gates; declared workload, supported environment and measurable engineering targets.

tasks.title: Execute and record one overnight meeting soak
scope: Run the declared overnight synthetic/authorized meeting workload on the supported Windows environment.
Record stage p50/p95, non-history memory trend, queue peaks, control responsiveness and all failures under the documented conditions.
acceptance: The completed duration has evidence for bounded transient memory and responsive controls; failed or interrupted runs remain recorded as such.
Latency summaries include sample counts, failures and conditions, and do not become unsupported product guarantees.
validation: Execute the prepared overnight workload once, preserve metadata-only artifacts and compare measurements with the stated targets.
Do not keep rerunning blindly; record anomalies for SC-033D to route into scoped corrective tasks and justified follow-up runs.
out_of_scope: No unrelated implementation changes, broad model tuning or indefinite soak extension in this run.
prerequisites: SC-033A; an available overnight window, interactive supported Windows/device environment, synthetic or explicitly authorized speech and enabled test-provider credentials when used.

tasks.title: Execute targeted fault recovery and privacy inspections
scope: Run the prepared disk-full, network, long transcript, deletion-during-work, cancellation and restart cases.
Inspect app-managed logs, temp/cache files and configured crash behavior for raw media, credentials and unintended plaintext using synthetic canaries.
acceptance: Transcript/provider/storage faults remain visible and recover within documented limits, with incomplete or unsaved data identified.
Automatic diagnostics and app-created raw-media files contain none of the prohibited synthetic content or secrets.
validation: Record the expected and actual outcome of each finite fault case and each relevant artifact category; keep negative and unavailable observations explicit.
Route defects into scoped corrective tasks instead of expanding this verification block into general implementation.
out_of_scope: No real private meetings, full-memory dump uploads, exhaustive fuzzing or unrelated security certification.
prerequisites: SC-033A/B records; isolated disposable stores, controlled network/disk faults and synthetic privacy canaries on the supported Windows environment.

tasks.title: Assess acceptance evidence and close scoped regressions
scope: Reconcile overnight, fault and privacy evidence against every SC-033 acceptance condition.
For each blocking regression, define a separate bounded corrective task, its prerequisite and targeted rerun; assess completed fixes before release readiness can advance.
acceptance: Every required measurement/fault/privacy condition has passing evidence or a visible unresolved blocker; this leaf stays pending while blocking corrective work remains.
No measurable regression is dismissed to close the parent, and no unsupported latency or privacy claim enters release guidance.
validation: Review run completeness, environment/version identity, p50/p95 including failure samples, memory bounds and privacy inspection coverage.
Link corrective task evidence and only the reruns justified by those fixes; do not execute an unlimited fix loop inside this assessment.
out_of_scope: No implementation of newly discovered fixes in this assessment block; public release remains outside authorization.
prerequisites: SC-033B/C evidence and completed results for any separately added blocking corrective children.

tasks.title: Assemble personal release evidence and operating guide
scope: Compile the supported-environment matrix, resolved risks, remaining limitations and reproducible release checks.
Verify shipped dependencies/notices, data lifecycle, model configuration and recovery instructions.
Prepare reviewable release artifacts and release notes; public publishing requires its own authorized action.
acceptance: Every claimed supported scenario points to actual evidence; blocked or untested scenarios remain explicit.
All personal-release phase gates can be evaluated from recorded results.
The owner can install/use/recover/update the reviewed build with the documented instructions.
validation: Run a clean checkout release build and compare manifest/dependency versions to tested artifacts.
Review package contents, signatures, notices and guide against observed behavior.

tasks.title: Assemble evidence-backed release guidance and limitations
scope: Compile supported-environment evidence, resolved risks, remaining limitations, reproducible release checks and release notes.
Write the operating guide for install/use/update/recovery and check its data lifecycle, provider/model configuration and dependency/notice descriptions against actual behavior.
acceptance: Every supported claim links to actual evidence; untested or blocked configurations remain explicit.
The evidence index permits review of all personal-release phase gates without inferring passes from documentation.
validation: Review the guide and readiness record against prior task evidence, dependency notices, model pins and recovery/data policies; identify discrepancies as scoped follow-up work.
out_of_scope: Final artifact/signature/clean-machine verification is SC-034B; no public publishing or README maintenance.
prerequisites: Completed upstream release evidence and gates; exact intended release configuration and package inputs.

tasks.title: Verify the reviewable release artifacts and operating guide
scope: Build the release from clean source, compare its manifest/dependency/model configuration with tested artifacts, and inspect contents, signatures and notices.
Exercise the documented install/use/recover/update path against the reviewed build in the declared clean Windows environment.
acceptance: The actual artifacts match the reviewed configuration and contain no unexpected secrets or agent/reference material.
The owner's documented operating path works with the reviewed build; all support claims and phase-gate conclusions remain backed by evidence.
validation: Run one clean-source release build and the finite guide-validation path; record hashes, signatures, package contents and discrepancies.
Keep release readiness pending for material findings and route fixes into bounded corrective tasks with targeted revalidation.
out_of_scope: Producing reviewable artifacts does not authorize publication, a push, purchases or communications to third parties.
prerequisites: SC-034A; approved signing capability, clean standard-user Windows environment, synthetic test data and complete preceding phase evidence.

acceptance: Native overlay/capture/screenshot paths have real Windows evidence.
Encrypted native database distribution and standard-user installation have been proven.
Two-source transcription is durable, bounded and recoverable.
Two-hour Windows run and fault cases are documented.
Manual assistance is useful and meets measured latency/quality expectations or documented supported limits.
Cancelled/obsolete output cannot leak across requests/sessions.
Grounded document and meeting outputs preserve provenance, edits and deletion semantics.
The complete personal knowledge/notes/drafts workflow is verified.
Supported Windows compatibility, accessibility, installation, updating, backup and soak evidence are complete.
Personal release artifacts are reviewable; passing this gate does not authorize public publication.

task_types.group: Original feature-level checkpoint, not an executable prompt. Its children are additional completion dependencies; original depends_on, requires_gates and acceptance remain authoritative.
task_types.implementation: One bounded implementation outcome including its focused behavior checks.
task_types.verification: One declared evidence collection or assessment scope with explicit external prerequisites; not a promise to finish a long or unavailable run in one prompt.

coverage_convention: Child parent_coverage indexes are 1-based positions in the original parent scope, acceptance and validation arrays. All original items must be covered; a coverage map is not passing evidence.
